mechanical-energy.def: The sum of a system's kinetic and potential energies, K + U.

closed-system.def: A system that no energy enters or leaves: no external force does net work on it. An open system exchanges energy with its surroundings.

conservation-of-energy.def: Energy is never created or destroyed: a system's energy changes only by the energy transferred across its boundary.

energy-bar-chart.def: Bars showing each form of a system's energy at two moments, plus any work across the boundary; the bars must balance.

dissipated-energy.def: Mechanical energy turned into thermal energy (and sound) by nonconservative forces such as kinetic friction; it is still energy, just no longer mechanical.
